description: A typed complete-future Plan has separate feasible and ideal branches, dated practical abilities and performances, and a designated actual branch. Under explicit duty-to-ideal interpretation and ideal/feasible overlap, branch ought-implies-can follows by the exact imported compatibility theorem. The closed debtPlan has retained stipulated repayment duty, no present ability, a feasible recovery alternative, no future ability or performance on its actual non-recovery branch, and no feasible original-object return. Actual-branch abilities agree with its Case. These are conditional formal controls, with attribution and moral/agency applicability deferred; no root change.
